info.name: Amazon Dynamodb Create a Dynamodb Table

items.docs: Creates a new table in DynamoDB. The CreateTable operation adds a new table to your account. Table names must be unique within each Region. The table is created with the specified key schema, attribute definitions, provisioned throughput settings, and optional secondary indexes.

info.name: Amazon Dynamodb Describe a Dynamodb Table

items.docs: Returns information about the table, including the current status of the table, when it was created, the primary key schema, and any indexes on the table.

info.name: Amazon Dynamodb Update a Dynamodb Table

items.docs: Modifies the provisioned throughput settings, global secondary indexes, or DynamoDB Streams settings for a given table. You can only perform one of the following operations at once: modify provisioned throughput, enable/disable Streams, remove a global secondary index, or create a new global secondary index.

info.name: Amazon Dynamodb Delete a Dynamodb Table

items.docs: Deletes a table and all of its items. After a DeleteTable request, the specified table is in the DELETING state until DynamoDB completes the deletion. Any items in the table are deleted.
Returns an array of table names associated with the current account and endpoint. The output from ListTables is paginated, with each page returning a maximum number of 100 table names.
